spec_defects.description: The pinned successful read responses describe bare resource arrays (and /me describes a bare user). The provider documents a common object wrapper with an items array, has_more and quota fields for all responses. Generated bare-array witnesses are rejected intentionally; the node retains the documented wrapper.

auth_evidence.description: The spec does not attach security requirements to the selected operations. Offline route tests independently assert key and access_token query placement from the updated provider authentication guide. Credentials are existing user-supplied values; this integration does not implement OAuth sign-in.

fixtures: wrapper.json is a synthetic offline test fixture using the documented wrapper fields, not a claimed provider-authored response.
